versos.grego: Πόθεν πόλεμοι καὶ πόθεν μάχαι ἐν ὑμῖν; οὐκ ἐντεῦθεν, ἐκ τῶν ἡδονῶν ὑμῶν τῶν στρατευομένων ἐν τοῖς μέλεσιν ὑμῶν;

controles.web: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?
controles.kjv: From whence come wars and fightings among you? come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members?
controles.livre: De onde vêm as guerras e brigas entre vós? Acaso não vêm disto, das vossas cobiças que guerreiam nos membros do vosso corpo?

versos.grego: ἐπιθυμεῖτε, καὶ οὐκ ἔχετε· φονεύετε καὶ ζηλοῦτε, καὶ οὐ δύνασθε ἐπιτυχεῖν· μάχεσθε καὶ πολεμεῖτε. οὐκ ἔχετε διὰ τὸ μὴ αἰτεῖσθαι ὑμᾶς·

controles.web: You lust, and don’t have. You kill, covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.
controles.kjv: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye ask not.
controles.livre: Cobiçais, e nada tendes; matais e sois invejosos, mas não conseguis obter; combateis e guerreais, mas nada tendes, porque não pedis.

versos.grego: αἰτεῖτε καὶ οὐ λαμβάνετε, διότι κακῶς αἰτεῖσθε, ἵνα ἐν ταῖς ἡδοναῖς ὑμῶν δαπανήσητε.

controles.web: You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it for your pleasures.
controles.kjv: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume it upon your lusts.
controles.livre: Pedis, e não recebeis, porque pedis mal, para gastardes nos vossos prazeres.

versos.grego: μοιχαλίδες, οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι ἡ φιλία τοῦ κόσμου ἔχθρα τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐστιν; ὃς ἐὰν οὖν βουληθῇ φίλος εἶναι τοῦ κόσμου, ἐχθρὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ καθίσταται.

controles.web: You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.
controles.kjv: Ye adulterers and adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.
controles.livre: Adúlteros e adúlteras,  não sabeis que a amizade do mundo é inimizade contra Deus? Portanto, quem quiser ser amigo do mundo constitui-se inimigo de Deus.

versos.grego: ἢ δοκεῖτε ὅτι κενῶς ἡ γραφὴ λέγει Πρὸς φθόνον ἐπιποθεῖ τὸ πνεῦμα ὃ κατῴκισεν ἐν ἡμῖν;

controles.web: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?
controles.kjv: Do ye think that the scripture saith in vain, The spirit that dwelleth in us lusteth to envy?
controles.livre: Ou pensais ser em vão que a Escritura diz: “O Espírito que ele fez habitar  em nós ansia com ciúmes?”

versos.grego: μείζονα δὲ δίδωσιν χάριν· διὸ λέγει Ὁ Θεὸς ὑπερηφάνοις ἀντιτάσσεται, ταπεινοῖς δὲ δίδωσιν χάριν.

controles.web: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
controles.kjv: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.
controles.livre: Porém ele concede uma graça maior. Por isso diz: Deus resiste aos soberbos, mas concede graça aos humildes.

versos.grego: ὑποτάγητε οὖν τῷ Θεῷ· ἀντίστητε δὲ τῷ διαβόλῳ, καὶ φεύξεται ἀφ’ ὑμῶν·

controles.web: Be subject therefore to God. But resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
controles.kjv: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
controles.livre: Sujeitai-vos, pois, a Deus; resisti ao diabo, e ele fugirá de vós.

versos.grego: ἐγγίσατε τῷ Θεῷ, καὶ ἐγγίσει ὑμῖν. καθαρίσατε χεῖρας, ἁμαρτωλοί, καὶ ἁγνίσατε καρδίας, δίψυχοι. ταλαιπωρήσατε καὶ πενθήσατε καὶ κλαύσατε·

controles.web: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners; and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
controles.kjv: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.
controles.livre: Aproximai-vos de Deus, e ele se aproximará de vós. Limpai as vossas mãos, pecadores, e vós de dupla mentalidade, purificai os vossos corações.

versos.grego: ὁ γέλως ὑμῶν εἰς πένθος μετατραπήτω καὶ ἡ χαρὰ εἰς κατήφειαν.

controles.web: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to gloom.
controles.kjv: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.
controles.livre: Reconhecei vossas misérias, lamentai e chorai. Torne-se o vosso riso em pranto, e a vossa alegria em tristeza.

versos.grego: ταπεινώθητε ἐνώπιον Κυρίου, καὶ ὑψώσει ὑμᾶς.

controles.web: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.
controles.kjv: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.
controles.livre: Humilhai-vos diante do Senhor, e ele vos exaltará.

versos.grego: Μὴ καταλαλεῖτε ἀλλήλων, ἀδελφοί. ὁ καταλαλῶν ἀδελφοῦ ἢ κρίνων τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ καταλαλεῖ νόμου καὶ κρίνει νόμον· εἰ δὲ νόμον κρίνεις, οὐκ εἶ ποιητὴς νόμου ἀλλὰ κριτής.

controles.web: Don’t speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law, but a judge.
controles.kjv: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of his brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.
controles.livre: Irmãos, não faleis mal uns dos outros. Quem fala mal de um irmão, ou julga o seu irmão, fala mal da lei, e julga a lei. E se julgas a lei, não és um cumpridor da lei, mas, sim, juiz.

versos.grego: εἷς ἐστιν νομοθέτης καὶ κριτής, ὁ δυνάμενος σῶσαι καὶ ἀπολέσαι· σὺ δὲ τίς εἶ, ὁ κρίνων τὸν πλησίον;

controles.web: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?
controles.kjv: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who art thou that judgest another?
controles.livre: Um só é o Legislador e Juiz, que pode salvar e destruir. Quem és tu, que julgas o próximo?

versos.grego: Ἄγε νῦν οἱ λέγοντες Σήμερον ἢ αὔριον πορευσόμεθα εἰς τήνδε τὴν πόλιν καὶ ποιήσομεν ἐκεῖ ἐνιαυτὸν καὶ ἐμπορευσόμεθα καὶ κερδήσομεν·

controles.web: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city, and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”
controles.kjv: Go to now, ye that say, To day or to morrow we will go into such a city, and continue there a year, and buy and sell, and get gain:
controles.livre: Atenção! Vós que dizeis: “Hoje ou amanhã iremos a uma tal cidade, e lá passaremos um ano negociando e lucrando”;

versos.grego: οἵτινες οὐκ ἐπίστασθε τῆς αὔριον ποία ἡ ζωὴ ὑμῶν· ἀτμὶς γάρ ἐστε ἡ πρὸς ὀλίγον φαινομένη, ἔπειτα καὶ ἀφανιζομένη·

controles.web: Whereas you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor, that appears for a little time, and then vanishes away.
controles.kjv: Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.
controles.livre: mas não sabeis o amanhã. Pois o que é a vossa vida? Sois um vapor, que por pouco tempo aparece, e logo se desvanece.

versos.grego: ἀντὶ τοῦ λέγειν ὑμᾶς Ἐὰν ὁ Κύριος θελήσῃ, καὶ ζήσομεν καὶ ποιήσομεν τοῦτο ἢ ἐκεῖνο.

controles.web: For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”
controles.kjv: For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.
controles.livre: Em vez disso, devíeis dizer: Se o Senhor quiser, e vivermos, faremos isso ou aquilo.

versos.grego: νῦν δὲ καυχᾶσθε ἐν ταῖς ἀλαζονίαις ὑμῶν· πᾶσα καύχησις τοιαύτη πονηρά ἐστιν.

controles.web: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.
controles.kjv: But now ye rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.
controles.livre: Mas agora vos orgulhais nas vossas presunções; todo orgulho como esse é maligno.

versos.grego: εἰδότι οὖν καλὸν ποιεῖν καὶ μὴ ποιοῦντι, ἁμαρτία αὐτῷ ἐστιν.

controles.web: To him therefore who knows to do good, and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.
controles.kjv: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.
controles.livre: Portanto, quem sabe fazer o bem, e não o faz, comete pecado.
